recovered_social_days.title: Cooking stream and the Potato–Tomato joke war
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: Tim and Anacondasin make potato chips in a collaborative stream. Termite jokes about flying her to Denmark; Rahu adopts a tomato-villain role; a parallel access dispute concerns Tree/Garden boundaries.

meaning.why_this_file_matters: Termite is unusually useful because the archive can compare three layers without collapsing them: a literary cultivation parable, repeated late-2024 social presence, and a clean 2025 supporter trace.
known: Chronicle repeatedly places Termite around Tim from November–December 2024.
The Great Book contains the buried-potato/lawnmower cultivation story.
A 20 February 2025 public support/coffee trace exists under the Termite name.
interpretive: Builder/cultivator and guardian roles fit the recurring growth/boundary scenes.
The literary and public/social Termite may be continuous, but identity equivalence remains source-sensitive.
unknown: Raw chats behind the Chronicle scenes are still unrecovered.
Whether the literary character and supporter handle are the same evidentiary person is not fully established.

meaning.confidence_note: High confidence in dated Chronicle/public presence; medium confidence in cross-layer identity continuity.
meaning.reader_rule: Read the casebook before the archetype labels: dated scenes and source mode are the documentary spine; roles and symbolic interpretations explain later meaning but do not replace the events.
